hint.text:
We also write analogies in this shorter form:

A : B :: C : D
hint.sound: We also write analogies in this shorter form: A is to B, as C is to D.

instruction.text: Look at the following relations, then complete the analogy with the word pair that fits best.
Select the correct word to complete the analogy.

atoms.finishSound: trumpet is to valve, as violin is to string.
knuckle is to finger, as Palm is to hand.
Lettuce is to salad, as ice cream is to milkshake.
The River Thames is to the earth, as the Milky Way is to the universe.
fin is to shark, as tentacle is to octopus.
funeral is to eulogy, as Wedding is to vows.

instruction.text: What word relation do these analogies express? Select the correct answer.
